title: Grateful Dead Live at Crisler Arena on 1989-04-05
source: Source: Master Audience Cassettes; Transfer Date: 2011-02-16; Equipment/Lineage: 2 DAK 5245 Microphones and 2 Realistic PZM Mics(Mounted on 1'x 1'x 3/8" plexiglass)>Realistic 4 Channel Mixer>Sony D6C Portable Stereo Cassette Recorder> Master cassette(Sony UX-Pro-90's)>Yamaha Natural Sound Stereo Cassette Deck K-902>SigmaTel Audio Sound Card/CD Wave Editor(tracking)>Traders Little Helper(flac level 8); Note: This was recorded with 2 sets of mics, 4 channels, mixed down to 2 channels.
